title: Sorting & Searching Problems
description: Master binary search, sorting algorithms, and sorted-array manipulation. These patterns appear in nearly every technical interview.
longDescription: Binary search and sorting are the backbone of technical interviews. This module covers binary search variants, merging and sorting sorted arrays, and the classic comparison sorts — merge sort, quick sort, and heap sort — including their stability and worst-case trade-offs.
whatYouLearn: Merge sort as the stable O(n log n) baseline
Quick sort partitioning and pivot selection
Heap sort and the worst-case guarantees
